notes.title: Hellpit is now 50% off (from $7.99 to $3.99) permanently
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I have listened to feedbacks from many of you who complained that price is too steep.
After much thought, I haved decided to reduce the price of Hellpit from $7.99 to $3.99 (50% off).
This price change is permanent.

I want to get my game to as many people as possible, hence the decision.

So now you can get it on Steam for $3.99 (or depending on your region, steam will autoconvert to your local currency)

Also big thanks to early buyers for supporting Hellpit.

Hope you all enjoyed playing Hellpit.

notes.title: Bug Fix: 11 Jan 2023
notes.notes:
- Fasten the camera transition during spawning.Previous camera transition is too long, making it annoying

notes.title: Bug Fix (Slippery after landing from jump bug)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

There's a bug which I I earlier ignored as minor issues which is:

[b]After you jump and landed on groud, you will move forward as if you landed on slippery ice.[/b]

Watching some gameplay footage and complains from other players,I realize it's a major issue.
I had now patched this bug.

Thanks,
Gamester

notes.title: Adding shadow to character
notes.notes:
Our game take place in dungeon
and somehow we need to keep the dark ambience while lighting the whole place
so player don't see in darkness.

As a result of too obsessed with getting the level lighting right, I miss out on character didn't cast out any shadow.

Shadow is as important especially when come to platformer like our game since player
can use shadow to guide them when jumping between different platforms.
And our game used mostly baked lighting to light our levels.
Casting aside technical mumbo-jumbo, it means character in our game mostly don't cast shadow 

So as a solution, I added blob shadow underneath the character 
which is better than having no shadow at all.

[b]Before and After image:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/5048faaed1179de6be6dbe0befa5bcdc3b24684f.png[/img]

Having see side by side comparison, character look really weird when there's no shadow.

Thankfully we caught this before our release.

notes.title: Check out list of traps featured in Hellpit
notes.notes:
[h2]These are list of many traps featured in our game :[/h2] 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/b6cd171ff0f46628173df46f6e83fed76c6a2560.gif[/img]
[b]Floor Spike[/b]
Annoying little bugger, you need to wait for each one before you can safely cross.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/4616006a03db01adfd6842e2446a988a9e44ad51.gif[/img]
[b]Swinging Pendulum[/b]
It swings left and right, nuff said.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/a1e9855f5152b97e18387f46b362a78ce3be541f.gif[/img]
[b]Swinging Axe[/b]
Not too difficult, just another obstacle to pass through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/fe33e5bae7e245bffc41650d519d9ced0964f920.gif[/img]
[b]Arrow Wall[/b]
This things come in pairs and would should arrows at different intervals (random).
Safe when at distance but when near not so much.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/abfaae25a483e6dac3ac9cfa884413dc057f21ab.gif[/img]
[b]Ramming Wall Spike[/b]
This thing can smash and impale you like Wile E. Coyote in Road Runner.
Look left or right before you cross.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/72c583ecbae485b4f424142bcdc27f354eadc635.gif[/img]
[b]Revolving Wall Spike[/b]
These things usually came in groups.
You need to use well timing to maneuver around these spikes.
First one was not the problem, is the one after that, is the problem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/80cf885a9b7bbaa5ca49424033ee089857532962.gif[/img]
[b]Roof Pounder[/b]
Careful, one wrong step and you will be instantly smooshed into tomato paste.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/a34fd5a4c37e95da98af3871d98c0d256869123c.gif[/img]
[b]Saw Blade[/b]
What any medieval game be without Saw Blade traps.
You need to time your jump over  these things though.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/2a8a1b244bdf5c4f066ae6cf625225d601553ede.gif[/img]
[b]Swinging Log Spike[/b]
If there's one trap that is a poster boy for this game.
This is it.
You will find these thing at each level.
Execute your jump well and there will be no problem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43299933/47186f3feab82be151cd1b8d6f338cd9e46f4a78.gif[/img]
[b]Turning Log[/b]
This thing is keep spinning forever.
You need to execute not once but several successive jump to pass through.
